pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained mice performing random-foraging VR task

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon Ca2+ imaging across three configurations: single-cell multi-plane (soma+dendrite piezo toggling), single-dendritic-spine (high-speed single-plane), and population imaging

parameters.main_system: Bruker 8 kHz resonant scanner, Chameleon Ultra II (920 nm green) + Fidelity-2 (1070 nm red)
parameters.spine_system: custom ScanImage-controlled 2P microscope, Chameleon Ultra II at 1030 nm for jRGECO1a
parameters.single_cell_multiplane: 40x objective, piezo toggling, 1.0-1.5x zoom, 5.05-11.89 Hz depending on jump distance
parameters.spine_imaging: 16x objective, 60x zoom, 128x128 px, 120 Hz, 45-60 s per dendritic segment

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon Ca2+ time series across imaging configurations
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker 8kHz resonant 2-photon microscope; custom ScanImage 2P microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-cell optogenetic place-field induction via targeted LED photostimulation synchronized to two-photon image acquisition

parameters.led: 620 nm, ultra-fast/ultra-high-power (UHP-T-620-SR, Prizmatix), 30-40 mW at sample
parameters.protocol: 5 baseline laps, then 1 s photostimulation for 5 consecutive laps at a fixed track location
parameters.synchronization: custom pockel-blanking circuit gating LED during galvo flyback/piezo toggling

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: induced place field with pre/post-induction Ca2+ imaging data

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction and cross-day image registration: iterative target-based SIMA rigid registration for single-cell data, and affine ECC-warp cross-day alignment for population data

parameters.single_cell: modified rigid 2D SIMA registration seeded from somatic plane displacements, iterative decreasing-displacement refinement
parameters.frame_masking: frame-by-frame correlation to time-averaged FoV, z-score rolling-mean threshold, low-correlation frames masked NaN
parameters.population_cross_day: affine warp matrices via Enhanced Correlation Coefficient (ECC) maximization, 5000 iterations, OpenCV

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, cross-day-registered imaging datasets

pipeline_steps.technique: ROI curation: hand-drawn dendritic/somatic ROIs with morphological path-length annotation for single-cell data (FIJI), automated subROI segmentation, and Suite2p-based automated ROI detection with mCherry-based genotype classification for population data

parameters.single_cell_roi: hand-drawn on motion-corrected time-averaged FoVs, annotated with compartment type and branch-wise path length to soma
parameters.subroi_segmentation: 2 um segments along dendritic ROI long axis
parameters.population_roi: Suite2p detection on concatenated 5-session datasets, GUI-curated
parameters.genotype_classification: ROI overlay on aligned red (mCherry) channel to classify KO (mCherry+) vs. WT (mCherry-)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: curated, annotated somatic/dendritic/spine ROIs with genotype labels

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantitative analysis of electrophysiological properties (input-output, membrane, action potential, and afterhyperpolarization properties) using custom MATLAB and Python code

parameters.ap_ahp_criterion: assessed at lowest-amplitude current injection eliciting AP firing
parameters.ap_attenuation: amplitude reduction of last vs. first AP at 2 nA max current injection
parameters.exclusion: 5 cells excluded for unstable input resistance measurement

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: quantified intrinsic and AP/AHP electrophysiological properties

pipeline_steps.technique: Ca2+ signal processing: rolling-window baseline (max-of-min) estimation for DF/F calculation and downstream event detection
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: DF/F traces

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: purified plasmid DNA solution for electroporation

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed virtual-reality linear-track navigation for water reward

parameters.water_restriction: mice maintained at ≥90% baseline body weight
parameters.running_frame_definition: imaging frame during which the mouse ran at ≥1 cm/s
parameters.intertrial_interval: 0.5-2.0 s, LCD screens blanked; data during ITIs excluded from analyses

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: animal position/velocity and reward-event traces synchronized to imaging
pipeline_steps.hardware: array of LCD monitors driven by rotation of a running wheel

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-context behavioral paradigm with one pseudorandomly located reward zone

parameters.reward_delivery: initial non-operant water drop on reward-zone entry via capacitive lick-sensing port; additional licks within the zone trigger operant delivery under a fixed ratio 2 schedule for 2 seconds

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behavioral/imaging session in a single familiar context

pipeline_steps.technique: Multi-context behavioral paradigm across four sequential novel virtual environments

parameters.n_contexts: 4 novel 3-meter contexts, teleporting after 12 or 15 laps each, then revisited in an infinite loop for the remainder of a 30-minute session
parameters.reward_zone_width: 7.5 cm, fixed unique location per context for 6/7 mice
parameters.purpose: boost probability of spontaneous place-field formation via novel-context exposure

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behavioral/imaging session across multiple novel contexts

pipeline_steps.technique: Dual-plane (somatic and distal-tuft) 2-photon Ca2+ imaging of XCaMP-R with rapid axial toggling

parameters.optics: 575 nm dichroic (575dcxr, Chroma) and HQ607/45m-2p emission filter (Chroma) to a GaAsP PMT (7422P-40, Hamamatsu)
parameters.frame_size: 512x512 pixels; FOV 221.25-334.12 microns wide; resolution 0.43-0.65 microns/pixel
parameters.objective: 40X NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.axial_toggling: piezoelectric device (Bruker) toggles objective between somatic (stratum pyramidale) and distal tuft (stratum lacunosum moleculare) planes
parameters.artifact_mitigation: 65 ms wait time introduced after each axial toggle before acquisition

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw dual-plane Ca2+ fluorescence video
pipeline_steps.hardware: Fidelity-2 1070 nm fiber laser; piezoelectric objective-toggling device (Bruker); 40X NIR water-immersion objective (Nikon); GaAsP PMT (Hamamatsu)

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-session field-of-view matching via iterative piezoelectric parameter tuning

parameters.method: time-averaged FoVs from 30-60 s test recordings compared to motion-corrected, time-averaged FoVs from the prior session; piezoelectric parameters iteratively tuned until images were indistinguishable

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: short test recordings and prior-session motion-corrected FoVs
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: matched focal plane across behavioral sessions

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction via iterative template-matching registration
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, time-averaged fields of view
pipeline_steps.source_quote: recently described iterative, template-matching approach designed for relatively dim signals

pipeline_steps.technique: Manual ROI drawing over motion-corrected fields of view, annotated by dendritic-arbor position

parameters.roi_definition: each dendritic ROI = entire cross-section of one unique branch present in the field of view; no repeated ROIs per branch
parameters.annotation_basis: z-stack images of each CA1 PN at 1-micron axial resolution under general anesthesia

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: motion-corrected, time-averaged FoVs and z-stack images
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: hand-drawn somatic and distal tuft dendritic ROIs

pipeline_steps.technique: 3D digital reconstruction of one illustrative CA1 pyramidal neuron

parameters.denoising: custom Python script to denoise 3D images and correct depth-related signal-intensity changes not corrected by laser-power compensation
parameters.tracing: automatic tracing, filling, and segmentation via a custom Jython script

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: 3D z-stack image of one CA1 PN
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: traced, filled, and segmented 3D neuronal reconstruction

pipeline_steps.technique: ΔF/F calculation with iterative baseline re-estimation and wavelet denoising

parameters.initial_baseline: rolling maximum of rolling minimums with Gaussian smoothing, σ = 10 s
parameters.masking: frames where signal dropped ≥1 SD below baseline were masked before denoising, then reinserted
parameters.denoising: Python adaptation of the MATLAB wavelet denoising implementation (wden)
parameters.final_baseline: second baseline pass on denoised data, σ = 1 s Gaussian kernel
parameters.final_smoothing: ΔF/F = (raw - baseline)/baseline, smoothed with σ = 0.5 s Gaussian kernel
parameters.iterations: 3 iterative cycles of baseline re-estimation while masking previously identified transients

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: raw Ca2+ fluorescence traces per ROI
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised ΔF/F traces (and z-scored variants for machine-learning analyses)

pipeline_steps.technique: Event deconvolution to generate binary Ca2+ event trains

parameters.baseline: max-min baseline with σ = 5 frames Gaussian smoothing

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: binary deconvolved event trains

pipeline_steps.technique: Ca2+ transient detection via template matching

parameters.template_generation: initial transients identified with a 1.5 σ onset / 0.5 σ offset cutoff and minimum 0.25 s duration, then averaged into peri-event time histograms (1 s before to 3 s after peak) per compartment and dataset
parameters.detection: ΔF/F traces continuously correlated to the template via sliding window; peak-detection algorithm applied with a correlation threshold of R = 0.85
parameters.event_bounds: symmetric 1 σ threshold, minimum duration 1 s, maximum duration 30 s, lockout period 0.5 s
parameters.iteration: 3 iterative cycles of baseline re-estimation masking previously identified transients

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected Ca2+ transients (onset, offset, amplitude)

pipeline_steps.technique: Plateau-potential detection and classification in distal tuft dendrites

parameters.clustering: 2-component non-negative matrix factorization on z-scored, peak-aligned transient PETHs, followed by K=3 K-means clustering; highest-amplitude cluster labeled plateau, remaining two merged
parameters.reclassification: events exceeding the 95th percentile of the non-plateau cluster's amplitudes were kept as plateaus; others redesignated ordinary transients
parameters.classifier: ensemble of 10 support vector classifiers with L2 regularization = 1.0, trained on random subsets (33% soma, 90% tuft) and tested on held-out data; best ensemble (>99% accuracy) retained
parameters.final_rule: a coactive event across all tuft dendrites of a cell was called a plateau only if ≥50% of dendrites' events were classified as plateaus

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: events labeled as plateau potentials or ordinary Ca2+ transients

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-compartment Ca2+ transient coactivity and propagation analysis

parameters.isolated_transient_definition: a dendritic transient whose bounds did not intersect any somatic transient in the connected soma
parameters.coactivity_definition: two ROIs coactive for an event if one ROI's transient bounds overlapped the other's
parameters.time_lag_analysis: tuft signals averaged within-cell, transient detection rerun on mean signals, somatic ΔF/F triggered on mean tuft event onset when overlapping in time

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: detected somatic and dendritic Ca2+ transients
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-compartment coactivity fractions and relative time lags

pipeline_steps.technique: Prediction of somatic ΔF/F from distal tuft dendritic signals via cross-validated Ridge regression

parameters.model: 10-fold double-cross-validated Ridge regression on 100 random subsamples of N dendrites (N from 1 to the max imaged per cell)
parameters.scaling: ΔF/F traces scaled to [0, 1] before training/testing
parameters.cross_validation: circular top-level CV with non-overlapping 10% test chunks, iteratively predicted to produce one full fit
parameters.output_metric: mean cross-fold R2 accuracy score per N, plus a full model fit on all imaged dendrites

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: scaled dendritic and somatic ΔF/F traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predicted somatic ΔF/F and R2 accuracy scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning curve and place field calculation

parameters.position_bins: 150 position bins with a 7.5-bin Gaussian smoothing kernel (scaled up from a prior 2 m track's binning to match the 3 m virtual track)
parameters.multi_context_handling: traversals of a given context concatenated before computing tuning features

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning curves and place fields

pipeline_steps.technique: Comparison of spatial tuning profiles via circular distance and Wasserstein distance

parameters.circular_distance: minimal distance between two place-field peaks along the 3 m circular track (max 150 cm); most-proximal PF pairs used when multiple PFs present
parameters.wasserstein_distance: used as a reference-free metric for subthreshold tuning; 1,000 shuffled-data tuning curves used to generate 95% confidence intervals

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: circular-distance and Wasserstein-distance similarity metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Decoding animal position from spatial tuning curves via support vector classifier ensembles

parameters.model: ensemble of 100 support vector classifiers with 10-fold cross-validation, L2 regularization = 1.0, bagging classifier pipeline
parameters.position_binning: 150 position bins across the 3 m virtual track
parameters.scaling: tuning curves scaled to [0, 1] before training/testing
parameters.cross_validation: circular fit to 90% of data, tested on held-out 10%, repeated 10 times for mean fits and R2 scores

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded animal position bins and R2 accuracy scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Detection of de novo place-field formation events using a stepped-down confidence-interval threshold

parameters.first_pass_threshold: confidence interval started at 95% and stepped down in 10% increments to 100% - (5% x N_traversals), newly-discovered non-overlapping PFs stored at each step
parameters.formation_lap: first lap where in-PF hit count exceeded the mean of non-zero hit values; laps within the first 8 required no additional t-test, later ones required post-formation hits to exceed pre-formation hits by t-test
parameters.formation_frame: imaging frame where ΔF/F exceeded the 99th percentile of in-PF values on the formation lap, with the forward PF bound expanded by 10% of track length to account for backward peak shift
parameters.remap_handling: if a second PF emerged in the same context, hit rates before/after its formation lap determined whether the original PF was assigned a 'stop lap'

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial tuning curves across concatenated context traversals
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: candidate newly-formed place fields with formation lap/frame/location

pipeline_steps.technique: Validation of candidate newly-formed place fields

parameters.threshold: minimum confidence interval set to 100% - (5% x N_events), stepped down from 95% in 5% increments
parameters.overlap_resolution: when multiple validated PFs overlapped the candidate, the most similar was kept and others discarded
parameters.recalculation: formation lap and imaging frame/position recalculated for validated PF bounds

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: validated newly-formed place fields

pipeline_steps.technique: Calculation of place-field expression and formation metrics

parameters.expression_metrics: sensitivity, specificity, width, spatial information score, over laps from PF formation to the final PF lap
parameters.stability: log ratio of PF sensitivity at first re-exposure vs. the traversal in which the PF initially formed
parameters.peak_shift: position bins separating the formation event from the post-formation tuning-curve peak, x cm/bin, using a 300-bin spatial heatmap
parameters.formation_gain: log ratio of formation-lap PF hits to mean post-formation PF hit rate
parameters.peri_formation_velocity: mean animal velocity over [-1.5, 1.0] s relative to PF formation

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PF expression and formation metric values

pipeline_steps.technique: Prediction of newly-formed somatic place-field properties from distal tuft features via polynomial Ridge regression

parameters.predictors: tuft-to-soma activation lag and area-under-curve (AUC) around somatic PF formation
parameters.feature_transform: 3rd-order polynomial feature expansion of lag and AUC, scaled to [0, 1]
parameters.targets: PF expression/formation metrics and residuals of a previously reported peri-formation-velocity/PF-width correlation, normalized to L2 norms

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: tuft lag/AUC features and somatic PF properties
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predicted somatic PF properties

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-correlation of isolated tuft and somatic ΔF/F signals against non-spatial behavioral features across variable time lags

parameters.masking: dendritic and somatic ΔF/F traces set to zero outside frames of their own isolated Ca2+ transients
parameters.behavioral_features: velocity, acceleration, deceleration (frame-by-frame), running (Boolean, ≥1.0 cm/s threshold), rewarded/unrewarded licks (Boolean, onset frames)
parameters.scaling_and_lag: traces scaled to [0, 1]; correlation normalized by vector-norm product to [-1, 1]; maximum lag of 5 s in either direction
parameters.significance: fraction of ROIs with above-chance R determined via 1,000 shuffled-data R values and a 95% confidence interval

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: masked tuft/somatic ΔF/F traces and behavioral feature traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-correlation coefficients and lags between isolated Ca2+ signals and behavioral features

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level hypothesis testing framework

parameters.univariate_parametric: paired or unpaired t-tests with Welch's correction for heteroscedasticity when normally distributed
parameters.univariate_nonparametric: Mann-Whitney U (unpaired) or Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired) when not normally distributed
parameters.multi_factor: ANOVAs, or linear mixed-effects models with Geisser-Greenhouse correction when missing data precluded repeated-measures ANOVA

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

parameters.timing: electroporation >= 7 days post-surgery; imaging >= 2 days post-electroporation for sufficient expression

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single XCaMP-R-expressing CA1 pyramidal neuron per animal

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed virtual-reality navigation behavior: single-context sessions with a pseudorandomly located water reward, and multi-context sessions cycling four novel 3-m VR contexts to boost place-field formation

parameters.single_context: one pseudorandom reward zone/lap, 30 min, fixed ratio 2 reinforcement within reward zone
parameters.multi_context: 4 novel contexts, teleport after 12 or 15 laps, then looped for remainder of 30-min session

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behavioral trial data (position, licking, reward) synchronized with imaging

pipeline_steps.technique: Dual-plane (somatic and distal tuft dendritic) two-photon calcium imaging of the electroporated CA1 pyramidal neuron via rapid piezoelectric focal-plane toggling

parameters.objective: 40x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.acquisition: 30 Hz, 512x512 px per plane, FOV 221.25-334.12 um, resolution 0.43-0.65 um/px
parameters.piezo_wait_time_ms: up to 65, to avoid inertial-vibration artifacts

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw somatic and distal-tuft-dendritic two-photon Ca2+ time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction via iterative template-matching, manual ROI drawing over soma and individual dendritic branches guided by anatomical z-stacks

parameters.roi_criterion: one ROI per full cross-section of a unique dendritic branch present in the field of view

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, ROI-defined fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: DF/F0 calculation with rolling max-min baseline estimation, signal masking, and wavelet denoising

parameters.initial_baseline: rolling max-of-min, Gaussian kernel sigma=10 s
parameters.masking_threshold: signal below baseline by >= 1 SD masked before denoising
parameters.denoising: Python adaptation of MATLAB wavelet denoising (wden)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised DF/F0 traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Binary event deconvolution from DF/F0 traces for spatial tuning analysis
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: binary deconvolved event trains

pipeline_steps.technique: Template-matching-based Ca2+ transient detection, benchmarked against traditional variance-threshold detection

parameters.template_generation: PETHs from initial SD-thresholded transients, pooled and averaged per compartment/dataset
parameters.peak_detection: sliding-window correlation to template, peak threshold R=0.85
parameters.event_bounds: symmetric threshold 1 SD, min duration 1 s, max duration 30 s, lockout 0.5 s
parameters.baseline_reestimation: 3 iterative cycles masking previously identified transients

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected Ca2+ transient events with onset/offset times

pipeline_steps.technique: Unsupervised plateau-potential detection and classification in distal tuft dendrites via NMF dimensionality reduction, K-means clustering, and an SVC-ensemble arbiter, with an all-or-none cross-dendrite coactivity rule

parameters.svc_ensembles: 10, L2 regularization=1.0, trained on 33% (soma) or 90% (tuft) of events
parameters.coactivity_rule: >=50% of a cell's tuft dendrites classified as plateau and contemporaneously active

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: peri-event time histograms of detected Ca2+ transients
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified plateau-potential vs. ordinary transient events

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-compartment analysis of soma-tuft Ca2+ transient propagation, including a double-cross-validated Ridge regression predicting somatic DF/F0 from distal tuft dendritic DF/F0

parameters.regression: 10-fold double-cross-validated Ridge regression, 100 random subsamples of N dendrites
parameters.scaling: DF/F0 traces scaled to [0,1] before training

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-compartment propagation statistics and R2 prediction accuracy

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning curve and place-field calculation with shuffle-based significance testing, and tuning-profile comparison via circular distance and Wasserstein distance metrics

parameters.shuffle_ci: 95% confidence interval from 1000 shuffled tuning curves

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning curves, detected place fields, and pairwise tuning-similarity metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Decoding of animal position from somatic or distal-tuft spatial tuning curves using bagged support vector classifier ensembles

parameters.cross_validation: 10-fold, circular fit on 90% train / 10% test, repeated 10 times

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded animal position and R2 accuracy

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-correlation analysis relating dendritic/somatic Ca2+ signals to non-spatial behavioral variables (velocity, acceleration, deceleration, running, licking)
pipeline_steps.input_data_type: DF/F0 traces and behavioral variable traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: maximum lagged Pearson correlation per ROI-behavior pair

pipeline_steps.technique: De novo place-field formation detection algorithm identifying formation lap, imaging frame, peak shift, formation gain, and peri-formation velocity for each newly formed place field

parameters.formation_lap_criterion: first lap where in-field hits exceed mean of non-zero hit values, validated by t-test for events after lap 8
parameters.formation_frame_criterion: frame where DF/F0 exceeds 99th percentile of in-field values on the formation lap
parameters.peak_shift_correction: forward PF bound expanded by 10% of track length (30 cm)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial tuning curves across concatenated context traversals
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: identified de novo place-field formation events with formation metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Polynomial-feature double-cross-validated Ridge regression predicting de novo somatic place-field properties from distal-tuft dendritic activation lag and area-under-curve

parameters.feature_transform: 3rd-order polynomial expansion of tuft lag and AUC, scaled to [0,1]

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: distal tuft activation lag/AUC features and somatic place-field property metrics
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predicted place-field expression/formation properties and regression weights
